rationale: Pranav is a full-stack developer building AI-powered applications across healthcare, DAO tooling, and agentic systems, while Sai is a founder and AI researcher with deep expertise in computer vision, LLMs, and ML systems. Their complementary skill sets—Pranav's end-to-end application development versus Sai's research and specialized ML depth—create strong potential for collaboration on AI projects that need both implementation rigor and cutting-edge model work.
intro_message: Pranav Patel, meet Sai Sandeep Kumar Vijayarao — you're both Northeastern-based AI builders with overlapping focus on LLMs and applied AI, and your strengths in full-stack development and ML research could align well on a technical project.
